  redirect_limit = 5
  current_uri = uri
  
  redirect_limit.times do
    http = Net::HTTP.new(current_uri.host, current_uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = (current_uri.scheme == 'https')
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 10

    request['User-Agent'] = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; RSSFeedFetcher/1.0)'
    
    response = http.request(request)

      end

    else

    end
  end

# Fetch and parse RSS feed from the provided URL
url_string = kwargs[:url] || args.first || "https://news.google.com/rss"

begin
  uri = URI.parse(url_string)
  
  # HTTP 302 indicates redirect - follow redirects
  response = nil
  redirect_limit = 5
  current_uri = uri
  
  redirect_limit.times do
    http = Net::HTTP.new(current_uri.host, current_uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = (current_uri.scheme == 'https')
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 10
    
    request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(current_uri.request_uri)
    request['User-Agent'] = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; RSSFeedFetcher/1.0)'
    
    response = http.request(request)
    
    case response
    when Net::HTTPSuccess
      break
    when Net::HTTPRedirection
      location = response['location']
      if location.nil? || location.empty?
        raise "Redirect without location header"
      end
      current_uri = URI.parse(location)
    else
      raise "HTTP #{response.code} #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    raise "Too many redirects or final response not successful"
  end
  
  feed_content = response.body
  
  # Parse RSS/Atom feed
  feed = RSS::Parser.parse(feed_content, false)
  
  items = []
  
  if feed.nil?
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "parse_error",
      error_message: "Failed to parse feed content from #{url_string}",
      retriable: false
    )
  else
    # Handle both RSS and Atom feeds
    feed_items = feed.items rescue []
    feed_items = feed.entries if feed_items.empty? && feed.respond_to?(:entries)
    
    feed_items.each do |item|
      title = item.title.to_s.strip rescue ""
      link = (item.link.to_s rescue "") || (item.respond_to?(:links) && item.links.first&.href.to_s rescue "")
      pub_date = (item.pubDate || item.published || item.updated).to_s rescue ""
      
      items << {
        title: title,
        link: link,
        pubDate: pub_date
      }
    end
    
    result = Agent::Outcome.ok(
      value: {
        items: items,
        feed_url: url_string
      },
      provenance: {
        sources: [{
          uri: url_string,
          fetched_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
          retrieval_tool: "rss_feed_fetcher",
          retrieval_mode: "live"
        }]
      }
    )
  end
  
rescue => e

  )
